subject: Emotions
title: Polyamory and Jealousy
description: A quick win: understand Polyamory and Jealousy.

hook.text: Polyamorous people still feel jealousy. The difference isn't immunity—it's how they process it.

buildup.text: The polyamory community coined 'compersion'—feeling joy when your partner enjoys another relationship.

discovery.text: Studies show polyamorous people report similar jealousy levels but use more communication strategies to manage it.

twist.text: Compersion isn't the absence of jealousy. Many polyamorous people feel both emotions at once about the same event.

climax.text: Monogamy manages jealousy through exclusion rules. Polyamory manages it through radical communication. Both have costs.

punchline.text: No relationship structure eliminates jealousy. Only awareness tames it.

quiz.question: What is 'compersion'?
options: Joy at a partner's other relationship
